manga_title: My Wife Is From a Thousand Years Ago 207
text:
Page 001
001-1. junitiusjutiujutitis RP CL/RD TS TL Paragon Scans
001-2. discord.gg/pErHvcxdrx

Page 002
002-1. A HOUSE HUH..
002-2. THE AVERAGEPRICEOFTHEPLACEICURRENTLY LIVEINISMORETHAN8OOOSINCEIT'SA SMALL APARTMENT WHERE THE TOTAL PRICE IS LOW AND THE UNIT PRICEISABIT HIGH.IFIWERETOBUYAPLACE,I WOULDNT BUYAPLACE THISOLD.IT WOULD BE THE SLIGHTLY NEWER ONES THAT HAVE ANAVERAGEPRICEOFGOOOFOR1OOSQUARE METERS. A THIRD OF THE DOWNWILL ALTTLE OVER2O,OOO.IFTHERE'SSUITABLEPLACES,800 SQUAREMETERSWILLALSOBEFINEANDMORE CONVENIENT.IFI'MSHORTOF A FEWTHOUSANDICAN BORROW MYFROMMY DADAND OTHERS,GIVINGME A MUCH WIDER RANGE OF OPTIONS. 嗒
002-3. MENTAU CALCULATOR
002-4. 发家政富
002-5. I NEVER THOUGHT ABOUT BUYING A PLACE SO SOON, BUT MY SAVINGS UNKNOWINGLYINCREASED, SOI NATURALLYHAVE THIS THOUGHT..
002-6. EVEN IF SHE DOESN'T DO ANYTHING BUTLAUNDRY, COOKING, ANDPLAYING GAMES, THE DIFFERENCE BETWEEN HAVING A GIRLFRIEND AND NOT HAVING ONE IS HUGE.
002-7. IN TERMS OF FOOD, CLOTHING, HOUSING AND TRANSPORTATION, IT IS REALLY DIFFICULT TO SAVE MONEY WHEN YOU ARE SINGLE.

Page 003
003-1. WHEN YOU GET MARRIED, YOU DON'T HAVE SO MANY BELLS AND WHISTLES, AND YOULIVEASTABLELIFE,AND YOU SAVE MONEYWITHOUT EVENREALIZING IT.
003-2. DOON
003-3. COOKING AT HOME FOR A MONTHMAYNOTSAVEYOU MUCH COMPARED TOORDERING TAKEOUTFOR A MONTH, BUT BY EXTENDINGTHEDAYS,YOUCAN SAVEALOTOFUNNECESSARY EXPENSIVES IN ALL ASPECTS.
003-4. IF YOU HAD COME TWO YEARS EARLIER, WE MIGHT HAVE MOVED INTO A NEW PLACE BY NOW.
003-5. IFI CAME TWO YEARS EARLIER,I MIGHT'VE STABBED YOU TO DEATH.

Page 004
004-1. WHAT ARE YOU DOING!?
004-2. YOU SMELL GOOD AFTER SHOWERING, I USED TO THINK THAT PEOPLEINANCIENT TIMES WERE SMELLY.
004-3. IN THE PAST,THERE WAS NO HOT WATER TO TAKE A SHOWER EVERY DAY. IT WAS NORMAL TO HAVE A STINKY SMELL.THERE WEREN'T STUFF LIKE BODY WASH,SO YOU COULD ONLY WIPE YOUR BODY WITH A CLOTH.
004-4. AFTER WE BUY AHOME,DO WE HAVE TO MOVE TO A NEW PLACE?
004-5. WE'RE ALREADY FAMILIARWITHPEOPLE AROUND HERE,DOWE HAVE TO GET fO KNOW THENEW NEIGHBORS FOR THE ID?
004-6. THERE'S NO NEED, WE CAN GET IT DONE HERE FIRST. WE STILL NEED TO SAVEFOR ANOTHER YEAR ANYWAY.
004-7. OR WE'LL COME BACK HERE WHEN WE'RE GETTING IT DONE.
004-8. IT'S NOT EASY TO GET TO KNOW THE NEIGHBORS AROUND HERE,
004-9. AUNTIE HENG AND THE OTHERS ARE A DIFFERENT STORY BECAUISE I'VE LIVED HERE SINCE I WAS A CHILD, AND THIS COMMUNITY IS RELATIVELY OLD.IT WAS NOT LIKE THIS BEFORE...

Page 005
005-1. YOU'LLKNOW IN THE FUTURE THAT THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN NEIGHBORS IN THOSE HIGH-RISE BUILDINGS NOWADAYSIS VERY COLD.
005-2. YOU DON'T HAVE TO THINK ABOUT THAT, I'LL TAKE CARE OF EVERY- THING FOR YOU. JUST PLAY GAMES AND READ GOOD BOOKS,I'LL TAKE CARE OF EVERYTHING ELSE.
005-3. IT WILL BE A YEARSOON. ATTHE BEGINNING,I THOUGHT ABOUTGOINGBACKEVERYDAY, BUT NOWI'MWORRIEDABOUT GOING BACKSUDDENLY...
005-4. YOU CAN SIT IN MY EMBRACE WHILE YOU PLAY A MATCH.
005-5. YOU'LL POKE ME.
005-6. Xu Qing sent an invitation.

Page 006
006-1. 司 嗅 回 司
006-2. DOES IT SMELL GOOD?
006-3. YES~

Page 007
007-1. HEHE~I JUST TOUCHED MY FEET.
007-2. I FORGOT THAT SHE'S ALSO A PERVERT. WAIT,WHYDID ISAY ALSO...
007-3. YOU'RE ALWAYS IN HEAT WITH ME, IS THAT AFFECTION?
007-4. AHEM... COUGH COUGH COUGH...
007-5. THIS IS A NORMAL REACTION FOR A NORMAL MAN TOWARDSSOME- ONE HE LIKES.
007-6. DON'T USE SUICH..WEIRD WORDS.

Page 008
008-1. NO MORE MESSING AROUND, I'LL QUIETLY WATCHYOU PLAY.
008-2. 姜信姜疑
008-3. 享可亨亨~
008-4. 哼享享
008-5. WHAT ARE YOu DOING?
008-6. I'MNOT DOING ANY- THING.

Page 009
009-1. THELOWERABDOMEN IS NOT A SENSITIVE AREA FORMOSTPEOPLE.OF COURSE, AS LONGASYOU MOVE A BIT, IT'LLCHANGE,
009-2. JUST KEEPING IT HERE CAN MAKE PEOPLE FEEL AT EASE AND A LITTLE COM- FORTABLE...
009-3. AIYA~YOU CAN CONTINUE PLAYING.
009-4. BY THE WAY, YOU CAN CHANGE THE NAME OF YOUR CHARACTER TO SOME- THING LIKE "GINGER PLANT OF KAIYUAN".
009-5. WHY EXPOSE THAT?
009-6. WHO WOULD ACTUALLY BELIEVE YOUR IN-GAME NAME? IF I CHANGE MINE TO ALIEN XU QING, DOES IT MEAN I'M FROM ANOTHER PLANET?
009-7. THIS IS CALLED REVERSE PSYCHOLOGY. NO ONE WILL BE ABLE TO GUESS THAT YOU ARE FROM THE KAIYUAN ERA AND ARE KILLING THEMIN SUMMONER'S RIFT.

Page 010
010-1. ...ALRIGHT.
010-2. THE WARRIORESS IS STILL TOO INNOCENT.
010-3. THIS WOULD BE CALLED UNDER THE LIGHT BUT IN THE DARK,RIGHT?
010-4. WELP, LET'S CONTINUE THINKING ABOUT MAKING MONEY TO BUY A PLACE,
010-5. OH?! THE ADVERTISING SPONSOR DECIDED TO USE THE VIDEO OF ME WEARING THE HOMEMADECHAINMAIL, HOLDING A SOFT SWORD, AND ARROG- ANTLYPERFORMING MOVES.
010-6. NEED TO FIND A SUITABLEVIDEO TO INSERT AT THE END, ONE THAT HAS A HIGH NUM- BER OF VIEWS.
010-7. Homemade Armor
010-8. Bilibili's favorites
010-9. Master of martial arts
010-10. Shit talker
010-11. Fair and impartial (playing games with his girlfriend while editing some videos)
010-12. Cute, new, and old uploader
010-13. AFTER HALF A YEAR AFTER HALFA YEAR OF DOING THIS, I'M NOW SOMEWHAT FAMOUS.
010-14. 10分钟前
010-15. When my wife whipped me with a belt...
010-16. LUG 1分钟前
010-17. When my wife whips me with a belt, she's even more of a martial arts master.jpg(Dog head dog head dog head)
010-18. 6小时前 I forgot about my wife whipping me in the front and forgot about it in the back
010-19. I DON'T KNOW WHO TOOK THEPHRASE WHENMYFATHER WHIPPED ME WITH A BELT, HE'S EVEN MORE OFA MARTIALARTS MASTER"AND TURNED IT INTO 'WHENMYWIFE WHPPED ME WITH A BELT, HE'S EVENMORE OF A MARTIAL ARTSMASTER"
010-20. 4小时前
010-21. Front row!!
010-22. LUG
010-23. 7小时前 Low family position
010-24. 哎呦，不错哦，发条评论吧
010-25. NOWTHECOMMENTS OF MY VIDEOS ARE ALL THIS, I'LL BE INFAMOUS FOREVER!
010-26. WHAT DO YOU WANT TO EAT TONIGHT?
010-27. I WANT TO EAT..
010-28. I DON'T FEEL LIKE EATING RIGHT NOW,YOUCAN MAKE'WHATEVER YOUWANT.

Page 011
011-1. I'LL GO WITH SMALL FRIED FISH THEN.
011-2. BY THE WAY, PINGPING ASKED ME WHY I CHANGED MY NAME, HOW SHOULDI REPLY?
011-3. YOUSAWA TIME-TRAVEL DRAMA AND CHANGED IT.
011-4. IT'S THAT SIMPLE?
011-5. IT'S THAT SIMPLE.
011-6. I WONDER IF FISHING TOO FREQUENTLY WILL MAKEHIMTHINKTHATIAM NOT STUDYING PROPERLY AND AM TOO IDLE?
011-7. FROM NOW ON, I'LL TAKE THIS BOOKWITHME EVERY TIME I GO FISHING, SO THAT I WON'T NE- GLECT MY STUDIES.
011-8. IN THE PAST, IF I HAD ABOOKON ME FOR NO REASON, SECOND MISS WOULD'VE THOUGHT THAT MYBRAINBURNEDOUT.

Page 012
012-1. This is what you call life.
012-2. In the past. it could only be called living.
012-3. In that era where entertainment was extremely scarce, every day was spent thinking about food, clothing. and shelter.
012-4. ⅢⅢⅢⅢ As soon as it gets dark, I go to my room.
012-5. Occasionally, when I have free time, I lean against the wall.
012-6. or lie on the roof and laze in the sun.
012-7. Nowadays,just reading a touching book or listening to a good song can make people feel the simplest form of happiness.
012-8. Live life to the fullest - it's all very easy to achieve.
012-9. There's also love...
